title: Jamaican Frankfurter Stew
description: A spicy and flavorful stew made with Jamaican seasonings, frankfurters, and stewed ingredients. Serve hot with a side of rice or bread.
instructions: Heat the oily in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the garlicky and cook until fragrant.
Add the frankfurters and cook until browned.
Add the Jamaican and stir to combine.
Add the stew and enough water to cover.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with a side of rice or bread.
